name: ADBSSR curved-envelope evolving pad
goal: Design a long-evolving cinematic pad using multi-stage envelopes with adjustable curve handles, up to ~20s stages, optional breakpoint/slope expansion, and a modulation envelope that can start from alt control (e.g. sustain pedal) instead of note-on.

source.title: TRAVELER: The Cinematic Hybrid Synthesizer | Official Walkthrough

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

inputs.name: pad_layers
inputs.description: Blend of analog + optional WT layers

outputs.name: evolving_pad_patch
outputs.description: Slow-bloom cinematic pad with curved envelopes

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.

steps.action: Set three envelopes: filter, VCA, and modulation. Open the on-screen envelope editor and drag curve handles on time stages.
Use long time stages (up to ~20s each) for cinematic bloom. Expand envelope to add breakpoint + slope stages (ADBSSR-style) when you need a mid-bloom reshape.
steps.expect: Pad swells and morphs after note-on

steps.action: Route filter envelope to stereo LPF cutoff with moderate amount; VCA envelope for amplitude; mod envelope to WT position, pan, or secondary cutoff.
Optional alt-control on mod envelope: start envelope from sustain pedal (or other mod-bus source) instead of key press for expressive delayed motion.
LFOs: choose from varied shapes including unipolar and slew/random; key-sync or free; tempo-sync optional; dedicate pitch or filter vibrato with fade-in on LFO1/2.
steps.expect: Gentle ongoing motion without fighting envelopes

steps.action: Finish with soft EQ, light chorus, long space/hall reverb (space algo up to very long tails). Keep limiter available as safety for dynamic patches.
steps.expect: Pad sits wide and deep without clipping

verification: Pad continues evolving after initial attack
Dynamics stay controlled with limiter if needed
